title: Antwerp House Dental
description: antwerphousedentistry.co.uk Antwerp House Dental Practice is a premium private dental clinic in Cambridge, England, founded in 2011 by Dr. Daniel Hayes and located in a 600-year-old historic building on Lensfield Road near Cambridge University. With 10 to 20 staff and a 4.9 out of 5 rating across 500 plus Google reviews, it offers dental implants, Invisalign, cosmetic dentistry, microscope-assisted endodontics and CEREC same-day crowns. Dr. Hayes holds an Advanced Diploma in Implantology and FICOI Fellowship status, and the practice is a Diamond Invisalign Provider. It also operates as a referral center for complex root canal cases from other Cambridge dentists. Technologies include CBCT 3D scanning, digital smile design, intraoral scanning and diode laser treatment. The team of specialists covering implants, orthodontics, endodontics and hygiene all work under one roof with payment plans available for nervous patients.
